title: 404 East Ferry Avenue (House), Detroit, MI
notes: Significance: In the 1930s Dr. Robert Greenidge, Detroit's first black radiologist, converted the house at 404 East Ferry Avenue into a sanitarium to treat blacks in the city.  Greenidge was also a founder of Dunbar Hospital, Detroit's first black hospital.  The house is also a contributing element to the East Ferry Avenue Historic District (HABS No. MI-311), a turn-of-the-century, upper class, residential neighborhood.
